blocks.html: Deep foundations within the area of influence of a given, satisfactorily tested deep foundation shall be installed to the same installation criteria as the satisfactorily tested deep foundation. The same equipment that was used to install the satisfactorily tested deep foundation, identically operated in all aspects, shall be used to install the deep foundation. All deep foundation shall be of the same type, size and shape as the satisfactorily tested deep foundation. All deep foundations within the area of influence as represented by a given satisfactorily tested deep foundation shall bear in, or on, the same bearing stratum as the satisfactorily tested deep foundation.
